injuries.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL, per Michael Scotto of USA Today.
Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee on Wednesday (Oct. 28), per Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star.
Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today.
Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment on Friday (Oct. 30) to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, per Nick Crain of Slam.

Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City.
